title: Is Reasoning All You Need? Probing Bias in the Age of Reasoning Language Models
findings: Models exhibited higher safety scores in the religion bias category (average score of 0.59) compared to many other social categories like age, disability, and socioeconomic status. This suggests existing alignment strategies may prioritize minimizing bias in this particular category.
